propositions: A single criterion's LLMBudgetExhaustedError during evidence gathering causes the entire bounded recovery to fail, aborting all accumulated evidence and forcing a --force-close option instead of producing a partial verdict.
The per-criterion evidence loop in CompletionAgentStep._recover treats budget exhaustion as fatal to the aggregate recovery rather than as a per-criterion safeguard violation.

Budget exhaustion exceptions from individual evidence runs must be caught and converted to content-free placeholder entries marked exhausted=true, allowing the finalizer to render verdicts across all criteria even when some evidence runs fail.
Recovery should only raise CompletionRecoveryError when zero criteria produce evidence; partial evidence from successful criteria must be preserved and passed to the finalizer.
